__HIDDENCAT__
This hidden maintenance category collects pages whose infobox names a picture of a summoned creature that the wiki does not have yet. The icon of the spell that summons it is a different image.

To fill a gap, upload an in-game picture of the creature under the exact file name that the infobox names. See [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data#Maintenance categories]].
